title: Private historical request audit
summary: Adds a disableable owner-only historical backfill and research report without changing live requests or prioritization
changes: Added owner-only historical audit start, status, report and cancellation with durable restart recovery and worker leases
Added isolated schema-7 history captures, current level/account snapshots and prestige evidence storage
Reused GD sessions, provider throttles and circuits for deduplicated current level and Creator Points lookups
Preserved unknown CP/rating and missing or conflicting prestige instead of guessing values
Added partial CSV enrichment with exact provenance and conservative wave/date matching
Added private CSV, JSON and Markdown coverage, rating-outcome, CP, repeated-level and waiting diagnostics
Kept candidate formulas analysis-only and all live reviews, waves, embeds and allocations unchanged
Added historical-audit regression tests and an owner runbook; extended quality checks to services
